text: ポケモンずかんの　ページが　きに　なるんでな！

structure.jp: ポケモンずかんの　ページが

structure.en: are on my mind, you see!

patterns.name: 〜ので
patterns.explanation: んで is a spoken, shortened ので and gives a reason: 'because'. The rest of the thought is left unsaid. きに　なるんでな = 'because I'm curious, you see'.

patterns.name: 〜な
patterns.explanation: な at the end softens what was just said, like 'you see' or 'you know'; it is common in older men's speech. なるんでな = 'because it does, you see'.
